authority_boundary: Reviewed evidence inputs are not self-authenticating. An independent reviewer must verify retained provider or institutional proof material binding the exact archive hash and historical publication time. Neither a current capture checksum, URL label, catalog update, Git date nor filesystem clock establishes historical bytes.
replacement_policy: Same-namespace evidenced supersession uses the explicit predecessor chain. Cross-namespace replacements quarantine both families. Orphan events cannot certify unaffected history.
source_dependencies: Explicit external supplement list required, including an explicit empty list when none are used. Each supplement binds source ID, SHA256 and qualified publication evidence no later than T. Embedded schemas and detail bytes depend on the exact archive proof and existing join/hash checks. Dependencies are checked after full-ledger version selection; unavailable corrections cannot resurrect predecessors. Dependency conflicts across duplicates quarantine the family.
threshold_basis: Inherited unchanged from ML-A2, frozen before ML-A3 measurements. Annual training cycle plus three independent quarterly blocks; monthly and district/type volume screens are not guarantees of statistical power.
admission_policy: PASS only for the entire conjunction. Rebuild status is externally verified after two independent builds; a builder must not certify itself. BLOCKED never authorizes ML-B.
target_a: Preserve full-rights, registered single-dwelling and required object-role gates. Cadastral reference/geometry and manual proposed relations cannot resolve them.
target_b: Observed Residential Transaction Unit Price; confirmed no-parking subset only. Any contradiction in acquired transaction evidence must stop the build.
privacy: Five bounded aggregate artifacts only; recursive privacy audit before writes and at comparison. No transaction IDs, row hashes, addresses, owner identities, contact fields or individual target values in public outputs.
